findings.summary: runtime readiness returned fixed true owner claims without probing canonical stores or runtimes
findings.resolution: fixed by fail-closed owner probes and an isolated TypeScript event-owner health probe

findings.summary: concurrent projection saves could let an older revision overwrite a newer durable snapshot
findings.resolution: fixed by serialized revision writes and flush-before-clear

findings.summary: fallback restore always preferred a stale primary replica over a newer valid fallback
findings.resolution: fixed by validating both replicas, selecting the highest revision, and failing on equal-revision conflicts

findings.summary: IndexedDB persistence acknowledged request success before transaction commit
findings.resolution: fixed by resolving only on transaction completion and rejecting abort/error paths

findings.summary: the active task route could not be pinned before its first event, allowing retention to miss the active route
findings.resolution: fixed by creating a normalized pinned runtime record before ingress
